sloka: न चाप्यस्य कपेर्घाते कञ्चित् पश्याम्यहं गुणम् ।तेष्वयं पात्यतां दण्डो यैरयं प्रेषितः कपिः ।। ५.५२.१८।।।।
transliteration: na cāpyasya kaperghāte kañcit paśyāmyahaṁ guṇam ।teṣvayaṁ pātyatāṁ daṇḍo yairayaṁ preṣitaḥ kapiḥ ।। 5.52.18।।।।

translations.english: "You are the king of demons. Hosts of gods and daityas efficient in wars are conquered by you again and again since you are a brave warrior invincible to gods and demons.
